title: Go Directly to Jail !
summary: A man is accused of counterfeiting money after being caught trying to pay for a Pastel de Nata with a bill that was discovered to be Monopoly money. The defendant claims the bill is real and that hasn't have a clue of what Monopoly even is. The case is a simple one, but the defendant's insistence on his innocence and the presence of a key witness who has a hidden connection to the case make it an interesting one to solve.

phases.note: Defense attorney presents argument based on cashier cross-examination.
Defense delivers closing argument summarizing gathered contradictions and evidence.
